meta.title: KUFS — Khalifa University Formula Student
meta.description: KUFS is the official Formula Student team of Khalifa University, Abu Dhabi. We are building the university's first electric Formula Student car for FSUK 2027.

whatIsFs.title: Europe's largest student engineering competition.
whatIsFs.body: {competition} challenges university teams to design, build, cost and race a single-seat car against a rulebook written by the {organiser}.
whatIsFs.judgingBody: Every team is judged twice over: once on the engineering — design defence, cost report and business case, in front of practising industry engineers — and once on track, over acceleration, skid pad, sprint and a 22 km endurance run.
whatIsFs.seasonLine: {headcount} students across {disciplines} disciplines, building a {architecture} single-seater with a {targetMass} target mass.
whatIsFs.tbcTooltip: To be confirmed — not published for the 2027 event yet
whatIsFs.shippingBody: It is the closest thing an undergraduate gets to shipping a real product: a fixed deadline, a real budget, a scrutineer who does not care how hard the term was, and a car that either finishes or does not.

progress.title: Where the {year} car is right now
progress.lead: We publish the build schedule and then report against it — including the parts that slip.

news.title: From the workshop
news.lead: Build updates, event reports and the occasional post-mortem.

sponsors.leadWithPartners: Every component on this car exists because somebody backed it. Our partners get engineering visibility, access to KU engineering talent, and a team that reports back.
sponsors.leadEmpty: We are building this university's first Formula Student car, and we are looking for the companies who will put their name on it. There is one founding season, and this is it.
sponsors.entryLineUnknown: There is a tier that fits your budget.
sponsors.entryBody: Cash, materials, machining time or expertise — in-kind support counts at its value. We will tell you exactly what each tier gets you and report back in writing at the end of the season.

recruitment.title: You do not need experience. You need to turn up.
recruitment.body: KUFS is {headcount} students across {subteams} engineering subteams and an operations division, building {university}'s first Formula Student car. Engineers and non-engineers alike — three of the eight scored events are design, cost and business.
